analysis: The supplied units are base_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 3159-3651), which are historical release notes for earlier versions. The patch for this file only adds a new v0.10.10 candidate section at head lines 11-39 and renames the v0.10.9 heading. That patch is truncated, and the head text is not supplied. The base lines I examined contain no executable code, configuration or security controls, so I found no concrete regression. The base text records prior security-relevant behavior: SSD prefix-cache controls (T-041), provider release signing, the dev-branch lane's relaxed installer signature check for -dev./-staging. versions, and App Attest authorization. None of it is changed by the supplied evidence. The added v0.10.10 section describes waitlist gating for new sandbox setup (`darkbloom sandbox setup`, TB-013/T-061) and new cluster pairing (`darkbloom cluster`). Its claimed behaviors are: coordinator-checked approval; fail-closed refusal when the coordinator is unreachable; `--yes` auto-joining the waitlist; unchanged behavior for existing setups; and a fallback to the old behavior if the coordinator offers no waitlists yet. That last point could be a fail-open path. This is documentation only, and the implementing source is not in the supplied evidence. A later pass should verify that the waitlist gate cannot be bypassed locally and that it does not alter installer verification or the administrator-approved GPU limit flow (TB-014/T-062). It should also check that the new `darkbloom waitlist` command only sends account identity to the coordinator over an authenticated, issuer-bound channel (A-008). I cannot judge these from the changelog alone, so I am not raising a finding. needs_deeper_review is set because the actual waitlist implementation was not supplied.
